name: vite-plus-kumo
description: High-performance Rust Vite & Vite-Plus plugin for enforcing Cloudflare Kumo UI standards and design system rules.

scripts.build:package: cargo build --release --manifest-path ../../crates/vite-plus-kumo/Cargo.toml && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),{execSync}=require('node:child_process'); const p=['../../crates/vite-plus-kumo/target/release/libvite_plus_kumo.dylib','../../crates/vite-plus-kumo/target/release/libvite_plus_kumo.so','../../crates/vite-plus-kumo/target/release/vite_plus_kumo.dll'].find(fs.existsSync); if(p){fs.copyFileSync(p,'./vite_plus_kumo.node');if(process.platform==='darwin')try{execSync('install_name_tool -id @rpath/vite_plus_kumo.node ./vite_plus_kumo.node');}catch(e){}} fs.rmSync('./dist/vite_plus_kumo.node',{force:true});" && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(fs.existsSync('./generated_allowlists.json'))fs.copyFileSync('./generated_allowlists.json','./dist/generated_allowlists.json');"
scripts.validate:release: npm run generate:allowlists && npm run build:package && npm run parity && npm test
